scope: same frozen source and generated inputs; all timed Guion and Python outputs checked against the independent oracle; separate source and artifact lanes

metric_limits.allocation: estimated guest-data budget charges, not host allocator calls
metric_limits.branches: executed guest conditional branches, not hardware branch-misprediction counts
metric_limits.host_operation_time: inclusive time at host-op boundary; nested parse/metrics timers overlap and must not be summed
metric_limits.vm_sampled_time: sampled interpreter-frame wall time, inclusive of host calls; one in every 1024 frames; attribution only, not final benchmark timing
